items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC7 implemented; scope limited to tokens, fonts, primitives, head cleanup and class-only caller fixes named in the mini-plan (heading weight fix extended to Settings/FormContainer h2s, same finding 9).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No runtime logic changed; fonts use font-display swap with system fallbacks if a file fails.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Removed third-party gptengineer.js script; no external hosts remain; no secrets; check-dist-secrets passes.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Unit tests assert token values against the sheet and file contents; e2e asserts computed styles, real font loading and zero external requests; heading guard test was added after the fix (not test-first).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: +~100 KB woff2 across 5 faces, fetched per face on use and cached immutable under /assets; CSS +gzip ~1 KB.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Keeps shadcn token names and every exported component/variant name; all files under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format, storage key, env or API contract changed.
